summary: Two-piece sleeve with integrated lower body and upper textured lid; circumferential middle band height 5.405 mm after a 0.125 mm axial increase.

required_interfaces.description: 28.9 mm diameter, 5.1 mm thick disc in a 29.18 x 5.405 mm cavity; two 25 mm coaxial openings.
Lower floor and middle sidewall are one solid. Only upper lid joint remains at Z=6.705 mm, flat and square without catches or locating features; adhesive only.

Upper-side ear with aligned through-slot 10.5 x 3 mm; slot sides at X=±5.25 mm align with inner neck decoration lines below it. Both marked recessed inner neck shoulder corners are nominal R4 mm; outer shoulder corners are R3 mm. Exposed lower-body ear underside outer perimeter uses R0.45 mm matching opposite-face edge rounding.

All imitation stitch capsules on both outward faces raised 0.4 mm above the nominal exterior plane, twice the 0.2 mm prior height; center pads and piping remain at 0.2 mm. Include the lower-body ear underside U-shaped perimeter with 1.9 x 0.6 mm capsules and nominal 2.7 mm pitch, matching the opposite face. The marked ear-root stitch is a regular 1.9 x 0.6 mm capsule raised 0.4 mm, with its lower portion trimmed at the circular body boundary.

external_references.description: Uploaded brown leather circular tag with lanyard slot and perimeter saddle stitches. Image is visual style reference only, not a dimensional drawing.
Green marks identify lower textured faceplate and middle sleeve ring to fuse into one part.
Vertical green mark identifies the circumferential side band for 0.125 mm thickening, implemented along height.
Green-marked cavity cylinder moves radially inward by 0.06 mm.
All raised stitch capsules on both faces doubled in height.
Pink-marked lanyard slot sides align with inner decoration lines immediately below.
Two green circles select left and right inner neck shoulder corners for nominal R4 mm.
Blue line selects lower-body ear underside outer perimeter for matching opposite-face rounding.
Pink U-shaped line selects lower-body ear underside for matching raised imitation stitches.
Purple mark corrects the ear-root stitch: regular size matching the stitch above, clipped at the circular body boundary.

assembly_story.installation: Place disc in the integrated lower body, thinly apply TPU-compatible flexible adhesive to the flat upper annular face, align upper lid and lanyard slot, and hold until cured. No mechanical locators.
assembly_story.maintenance: Bonded joint is permanent. Do not use solvent, heat or metal tools on the disc. Prototype fit before final bonding.

designs.description: Integrated lower textured floor and sleeve sidewall, plus separate textured upper lid.
